_comment: Clip S2 (recording_shot_list.md), variant (a): dash-jump, crouch held before landing (air-entry slide at ~600 u/s),
slide jump at ~0.3 s (free, sets the flag), land crouched, slide jump again at ~0.3 s (flagged and early: penalized),
land, and let the last slide run out.
Variant (b): move the second slide jump to ~0.6 s after that landing (no penalty expected). Fit (b) FIRST: it must
fit with no penalty (slide_hop_penalty_drag has no effect there, so the report flags it FLAT). If (b) does not fit,
the 0.5 s rule or the flag model is wrong: stop and write it up under G09.
Timeline ticks are 1-based sim ticks at 64 Hz, set from the sim's own landing ticks (check with
tools_fit/scenario_probe.gd). Copy each trial's jump and crouch ticks from the video (tick = (t - t0) * 64).
Crouch is held from before the first landing to the end, as in the shot list; a jump out of a SLIDE does not
store crouch, so holding it through the jumps re-enters the slide on each landing.
slide_hop_penalty_time is not fitted by default (< 0 = until landing). To test a timed penalty, add
slide_friction is a side read (G43 check on 0.1875) from the slide segments.
Alignment: first rising crossing of speed_h through value_u (the ground dash start).
Bounds are search limits, not game limits: a result on a bound is flagged in the report.
name: Slide-hop chain (S2)

params.name: slide_hop_penalty_drag
params.note: per-second air drag added while the penalty is active
